Text:
SEPTIC ARTHRITIS (NATIVE JOINT) WITH STAPHYLOCOCCUS AUREUS Administer parenteral therapy initially for approximately two weeks then can be converted to appropriate oral therapy.

Total duration of treatment 4-6 weeks depending on clinical response

---

References:

- Mandell chapter: Infectious arthritis of native joints
- Sanford keyword: Septic arthritis
- Up-to-date online
- Mathews CJ Lancet 2010, 375:846
- Coakley G Rheumatology (Oxford) 2006, 45:1039
Therapy:
## Methicillin-SUSCEPTIBLE Staphylococcus aureus

## Treatment

Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO BID ($) R,DI

Cephalexin 500 mg PO QID ($) [R]
Dicloxacillin 500 mg PO QID ($) [DI]

## Methicillin-RESISTANT Staphylococcus aureus

## Treatment

Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO BID ($) R,DI

Minocycline 100 mg PO BID ($) DI
Inpt: ORZID3 GMENU SEPTIC ARTH S. AUREUS
